title: Pinjol
genre: classic dangdut, Soneta-style orkes Melayu rock
mood: a comic cautionary tale, scolding with a wink
subject: a man who took an online loan to buy a new phone, and the debt collector messages everyone in his contacts, starting with his mother-in-law
caption: Classic Indonesian dangdut in the 1970s Soneta orkes Melayu rock style. Paired gendang hand drums playing the classic dang-dut groove, a high slap leading into a low open boom at the end of each bar; a bamboo suling flute filling the gaps between vocal lines; a mandolin playing tremolo melodies in the intro and between verses; an overdriven hard-rock electric guitar playing riffs and one short solo; a Hammond-style organ with a simple bass and kit backbeat underneath. A warm, slightly roomy live 70s orkes sound, the gendang, mandolin and lead vocal forward, the guitar loud in the breaks. Male lead with Malay cengkok ornaments and long melismatic held notes at phrase ends, and a female voice singing the quoted lines in the second verse. 124 BPM, A minor. A comic cautionary tale, scolding with a wink. No fast koplo kendang, no EDM beat, no autotune, no trap drums, no modern pop production.
lyrics:
[Intro - short mandolin tremolo phrase over the gendang, four bars]

[Verse 1]
Dengarlah kisah si Bang Jaka
Ingin HP baru, kameranya tiga
Gaji belum turun, hati tidak sabar
Pinjam lewat aplikasi, cair dalam sejam

[Pre-Chorus]
Bunganya kecil, katanya
Tapi tiap pagi bertambah

[Chorus]
Pinjol, oh pinjol
Sejam cair, setahun dikejar
Pinjol, oh pinjol
Mertua yang pertama ditagih

[Verse 2 - male voice, a female voice sings the quoted lines]
Subuh-subuh mertua mengetuk pintu
"Jaka, kenapa fotomu masuk ke HP Ibu?"
Teman SD, Pak RT, guru ngaji juga dapat
"Abang pinjam berapa? Jujur sama aku!"

[Chorus]
Pinjol, oh pinjol
Sejam cair, setahun dikejar
Pinjol, oh pinjol
Satu kampung tahu utangnya

[Bridge - rock guitar solo, then the gendang drops back in]
HP barunya dijual lagi di pasar
Kameranya tiga, harganya separuh
Utang lunas, malunya belum
Malu tidak bisa dicicil

[Outro - mandolin and suling, one long held note]
Sungguh, malu tidak bisa dicicil
